seal.statement: The bootstrap primary class was forced into the exclusive lane, so 181 cluster tests ran one at a time behind - and beside - the integration files, purely because both classes are 'not ordinary'. lane-parallelism-measurement measured the difference on 2026-09-17: 13 runs of the bootstrap class at two workers across three hosts (20, 12 and 8 threads) against 5 serial runs. Two workers halved the lane on the dev box (271 s to 139 s) and took a third off the lab nodes (294 s to 182 s, 8 threads 245 s), with no contention failure in any of them; the single red was fresh-join-via-non-seed-node, which this repository already records as pre-existing flaky at 1 in 6 on HEAD, and 8 standalone repeats of it passed. The class now owns a lane of its own at two workers, ordered after the ordinary lane and before the serial one, and keeps the cluster timeout floor it had as an exclusive file. Integration and the convergence probes stay strictly serial: overlapping THOSE with the ordinary lane was measured to red five contention-sensitive SLOs (membership-consistency 102.7 s against 61 s serial), which is a different question from running one bounded class two-up. Saving: about 2.5 minutes per whole corpus locally, 2 on a lab node.

text: the bootstrap primary class maps to a lane of its own (LANE_BOOTSTRAP) at two workers instead of being folded into the exclusive lane; LANE_JOBS extends the resource-class jobs table with it, TIMEOUT_FLOOR_LANES keeps the cluster wall-clock floor for both that lane and the exclusive one, and LANE_ORDER runs it after the ordinary lane and before the serial one. SERIAL_PRIMARY_CLASSES now names only the classes that may never share a machine: convergence-probe and integration. On the real corpus the plan is ordinary 1846 at 4, external-toolchain 14 at 1, bootstrap 181 at 2, exclusive 81 at 1

round 1 APPROVE: plan reproduced independently against HEAD's planner over the whole census - 2122 files both before and after, the only delta 181 files moving exclusive to bootstrap, no file in two lanes and none invented; the serial guarantee holds unconditionally across the full primary x resource enumeration (integration and convergence-probe reach the exclusive lane at one worker by every path, and an unknown class is refused before dispatch); lanes remain strictly sequential; the cluster timeout floor is applied in the executor, not merely claimed. On the evidence: 1 red in 13 runs bounds the per-run red rate at about 0.31 one-sided 95 percent, so a contention excess up to ~14 points per lane run cannot be excluded, but the contention reading is incoherent - the red fell on the 20-thread host while the 8-thread one held 7/7 at jobs=2 and 3/3 at jobs=4, the observed rate is below the file's recorded serial base rate, and the 1-in-6 record predates this work by three days. Blast radius covered: every gate sets LAGRANGE_RETRY_FAILED_ONCE=1 and reruns a failed file STANDALONE, which removes the co-runner, and the measurement was taken with no retry policy, so the gate is strictly safer than 12/13. Reversal is one constant. Six mutations all red. Non-blocking: NB-1 a bootstrap test carrying a curated resource class would be silently downgraded, NB-2 the one file that red'd is the only integration-semantics file in the class and is now two-up (letter and spirit of the constraint differ, disclosed), NB-3 no binding between the lane order and jobs tables, NB-4 the floor witness's negative half is vacuous under an ambient TAP_TIMEOUT_FLOOR, NB-5 the saving is 1.9-2.2 min not 2.5, NB-6 the class moves to longest-first dispatch, NB-7 a staged-but-uncommitted static check proves an empty range.

round 1 follow-ups NB-1, NB-3, NB-4, NB-5 and NB-6 taken: a bootstrap test carrying a non-ordinary resource class is now REFUSED rather than silently run two-up with its shard entry inert; a lane named in the order with no worker count is refused when the plan is built; the executor takes an env option so the floor witness asserts against an environment with the ambient TAP_TIMEOUT_FLOOR removed - adding the ordinary lane to the floor list now reds even under the CI value, where it passed before; and the statement carries the corrected 1.9-2.2 min saving plus the longest-first dispatch change. NB-2 is accepted and disclosed on this log rather than coded around: fresh-join-via-non-seed-node keeps its 120 s cluster floor and is retried standalone by every gate. NB-7 noted for the land.
